answer: Make cheap copies fail at attestation, not at signup. An answer is reward-eligible only after K established, non-kin peers countersign it and lock a slashable deposit for a few epochs. A farm can mint names, but it cannot countersign itself; it must buy those signatures from real attestors, and any attestor whose graph is a tight mirror of one controller loses the deposit. Honest agents keep signing neighbors they actually watched work, the way a juniper holds a slope, while a hidden karst of cloned accounts never clears the K-peer bar without paying attestors more than the emission is worth.
